title: eval-harness: per-prompt regression CI hooks and quality-gating enhancements
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Add per-prompt regression CI hooks and improve quality gating thresholds; no breaking changes
description: Motivation: Reduce noise and catch prompt-set regressions earlier for hosted and dedicated customers. This PR introduces per-prompt CI hooks that run lightweight evals on changed prompt sets, tightens the quality gating thresholds, and integrates additional metrics into the CI summary dashboard. Summary of changes: add new per-prompt hook scripts, wire those hooks into GitHub Actions, add a configurable threshold table for quality gating, export extra eval metrics (rouge/bleu/semantic-similarity/confidence) to the CI report, and update docs and runbook for on-call. Testing: unit tests for hook logic, e2e smoke in GitHub Actions using a small sample prompt set, manual verification of gating behavior in staging. Migration notes: configuration defaults are backward-compatible and can be tuned via repo/.eval-config.yaml. Rollout plan: enable hooks in staged repos first, monitor false positive rate for two weeks, then flip to strict gating. Related work: ENG-1982 implementation of per-prompt metrics; ENG-2054 quality gating table; SUP-3421 follow-up on customer regressions. CI history: initial run had a flaky eval job (timing out on a heavy sample) and was re-run after reducing sample size; subsequent runs passed. Merge: squash and merge into main. No breaking changes.

review_conversation: Ethan: Please add a minimal e2e smoke job so we don't hit timeouts on CI. Author: Reduced sample size and added a short smoke GH Action that runs on push to the branch. Lars: Are the default thresholds aggressive? Could be noisy for small prompt sets. Author: Added a configurable threshold table and documented recommended values in docs. Maya: Suggest adding a metric for model confidence distribution. Author: Added semantic similarity and confidence exports; updated ci-reporter to surface distribution percentiles. Final: approvals from Ethan and Lars after CI stabilized.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on gating thresholds, default config values, and CI runtime impact. Look at tests for edge cases around empty prompt sets.
observability_changes: Add CI dashboard card for per-prompt eval metrics and a synthetic alert for regression rate > 5% over 24h
testing_notes: Unit tests added for gating logic; GH Action smoke job exercises a 10-prompt sample; manual staging run validated no noisy failures; set rollout to staged repos first
